about: The rules of spec/formats/terrain.md: one shard of the BFBC2 tool suite specification's rule index, written by spec/trace.py --emit; checked by spec/trace.py --check.

evidence.ref: DICE's bundles of the game copy (dated before 2013: 1,021), round SPV1 2026-11-22: 450 heightfields, 42 material maps, 83 visual terrains, 42 water meshes, 42 visual waters with data, all in terrain-00.fbrb and named as described
game copy: 527 / 527 heightfields, 53 / 53 material maps, 97 / 97 visual terrains, 53 water meshes and 52 visual waters, all in terrain-00.fbrb; heightfield suffixes -000 (71 files) to -036

rules.title: Terrain resources live in the level's terrain bundle

evidence.ref: DICE's bundles of the game copy (dated before 2013: 1,021), round SPV1 2026-11-22: 42 Terrain entries, all 0 bytes, all `.res`
game copy: 53 Terrain entries, 53 of them 0 bytes, type Terrain, name `<Terrain>.res`

rules.title: The Terrain entry has no data
Header layout

evidence.ref: game copy: grid squares of 1 m on all 71 main blocks; 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 and 128 m on sub-terrains

rules.title: Heights
Triangulation along the (i, j)-(i+1, j+1) diagonal

evidence.ref: game copy: 71 of 71 main blocks (26 at 1024, 45 at 2048) have exactly this tail's length
spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: DICE's 30 main blocks: offsets, runs, padding and tree re-encoded byte for byte on 30 of 30; A = 4n + runs + padding on 30

rules.title: Main block tail: the depth map, a min / max tree, a lower envelope

evidence.ref: game copy: 456 of 456 sub-terrain blocks (312 at n = 64, 132 at 128, 12 at 256) have exactly this tail

rules.title: Sub-terrain tail: a min / max quadtree
Header values outside the usual pattern

evidence.ref: BFBC2's Xbox / PC twins: the converted Xbox height field equals the PC file byte for byte on 7 levels; on 13 others the heights differ where DICE edited the PC terrain, the structure is the same

rules.title: Xbox 360 height field
BF1943 height field header

evidence.ref: spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: 30 main blocks: every row's runs sum to n, maximal on 30 of 30; share of 255 / 0 per terrain as printed; DepthFiles one DepthMap.png per main TerrainHeightfieldData on 30 terrains
the meaning, from the editor field's name, MP_005's footprints and DSTR-TERR-4; nothing read in the executable

rules.title: The depth map: one byte per sample, run-length coded by rows

evidence.ref: spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: computed trees equal the stored ones on 30 of 30 main blocks

rules.title: The main block's min / max tree

evidence.ref: spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: sizes 22,363 / 88,412 values on 30 of 30; share of samples at or under each grid per terrain as printed; the finest grid under all samples on 15
stale envelopes from edited heights; the use from the shape of the data (a conservative lower surface per level of detail)

rules.title: The lower envelope: grids of 2 to n / 8 + 1 vertices a side

evidence.ref: rust/bc2-terragen/tests/ring.rs on the game copy, 2026-11-23: 12 of 12 single-ring terrains, the order, sizes and stitching as given; the rings of 25 - 49 blocks (MP_002, SP_04, SP_004_B, BC1_Harvest_Day) not measured

rules.title: A single ring: twelve blocks around the main block, stitched to it

evidence.ref: game copy: (width, blocks) = (4096, 128) x 41, (2048, 32) x 12; all 20 BFBC2 Xbox / PC twin levels convert byte for byte; BF1943's Wake Island, Iwo Jima, Guadalcanal read the same way
spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: DICE's 30 material maps: the row lengths add up to each block's length on 30 of 30

rules.title: Layout

evidence.ref: spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: 30 of 30 DICE material maps decode to 256 pairs on every row and re-encode byte for byte

rules.title: A row: pairs of 4-bit cells, a repeated byte starts a run

evidence.ref: spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: (width, rows) (4096, 4096) x 22, (2048, 2048) x 8; cells per metre 2 x 27, 4 x 3
SPG2-rest scratch measurement, 2026-11-22: SeaBed against height on mp_001, MP_002, MP_004, MP_005, MP_008, MP_009, for the four placements

rules.title: The cells cover the main block, rows along z

evidence.ref: spec/probes/terrain.py and SPG2-rest's scratch scan, 2026-11-22: 30 maps, 1 - 10 names, defaultmaterial first on 30; 31 paired grids hold all names, same indices on 0; the 201 names' categories in DICE's grids as given

rules.title: Indices name materials of the level's grid by name

evidence.ref: game copy: 97 visual terrains, N = 1 x 43, 13 x 43, 25 x 6, 37 x 4, 49 x 1

rules.title: Layout
Road blocks

evidence.ref: spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: 30 DICE visual terrains, 1,515 patch shaders, 3,069 undergrowth entries, every one ending 01 00; second string set on 30 (NAM_MP_003), shader name on 1,091

rules.title: Patch shaders

evidence.ref: MP_005: header (66, 1, 15, 7, 128); its 16,384 cells' tiled counts equal their non-zero flags

spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: 318 DICE patch maps; (W, S) = (128, 128) x 19, (64, 64) x 11, (16, 16) x 12, (8, 8) x 84, (4, 4) x 192; 358,282 of 367,872 cells' non-zero flags equal the tiled count, the rest rule-only cells with one flag

rules.title: Patch maps

evidence.ref: OPFOR's Wake Island conversion 2026-11-07: an Oasis-layout donor drew black tiled cells, an MP_009-layout donor (1024 x 512) drew correctly
the tile index in each cell is resolved against the atlas's tiles per row and rows, so another layout addresses other tiles

rules.title: Tiled layers must match the mask atlas's layout

evidence.ref: DICE's MP_009: 757 tiled masks in 51 tiles' blocks, MP_005: 1,033 in 59; OPFOR's Wake Island: 998 in 78 (flags 8 and 4); no tile named outside its block
spec/probes/terrain.py, 2026-11-22: flags over DICE's 30 terrains 2 x 5,367, 4 x 11,712, 8 x 56,352, 16 x 13,750, 32 x 4,864, 64 x 2,558

rules.title: A mask tile spans flag x flag cells
A visual terrain decodes whole and is written again byte for byte
PC and Xbox 360 visual terrain differ only where DICE edited the PC
SootMesh converts by the same rules
